product_name: ERA5-Land hourly data from 1950 to present
retrieval_query_or_filters: Metadata-only review of the rolling ERA5-Land hourly catalogue. No CDS request was submitted and no ERA5-Land bytes were acquired.
intended_use: Global land-state and antecedent-condition reference for flood, drought, wildfire, heat, snow and landslide research. ERA5-Land is a land-surface reanalysis/simulation product and is not labelled as direct observation or as a catastrophe-event catalogue.

licensing.terms_version_or_date: CDS CC-BY licence rev. 1; dataset metadata updated July 2026; reviewed 2026-08-10
licensing.attribution_requirements: Provide CC BY 4.0 attribution and the ERA5-Land dataset citation/DOI; indicate modifications and do not imply Copernicus/ECMWF endorsement.
licensing.share_alike_or_derivative_requirements: CC BY 4.0 permits adaptation without a share-alike requirement; attribution, licence reference and indication of changes remain required.
licensing.notes: The authoritative CDS catalogue identifies ERA5-Land as CC-BY-4.0 and DOI 10.24381/cds.e2161bac. Download through CDS requires registration and acceptance of the applicable terms.

redistribution.conditions: Source rights support redistribution under CC BY 4.0 subject to attribution and applicable CDS conditions. OpenCatastrophe approves metadata only; no request output has been selected, acquired or hashed.

privacy.notes: The reviewed product is a public gridded land-surface reanalysis/simulation dataset.

spatial.extent: Global; catalogue distribution at 0.1° x 0.1° with native model resolution about 9 km

temporal.extent: January 1950 to present, hourly; rolling daily updates make 'present' mutable and not a byte identity

variables_and_units.name: volumetric soil water
variables_and_units.description: Land-surface soil-water state across model layers; exact layer and parameter identity must be pinned in any retrieval.

variables_and_units.name: runoff
variables_and_units.description: Accumulated runoff-related model output; aggregation/time semantics must be preserved from the selected parameter.

variables_and_units.name: snow depth water equivalent
variables_and_units.description: Modelled snow-water-equivalent state used as antecedent-condition evidence where scientifically appropriate.

variables_and_units.name: 2 metre temperature
variables_and_units.description: Modelled near-surface air temperature over land.

review.notes: Metadata-only approval. A future artifact must freeze the complete CDS request, catalogue state, variables, temporal/spatial subset, format and returned byte identities. ERA5-Land uncertainty and its model/reanalysis semantics must remain explicit.
